scope: All 75 original remaining pseudo cases; complete independently specified grammar and diagnostic expectations.

nonshadow.scope: 45 original non-shadow pseudo corpus cases; excludes all30 host/host-context/slotted cases
nonshadow.method: Independent static source-contract diagnostic predictions, preserving original normative semantic acceptance/rationale. No parser execution, Cargo, runtime census, current registry truth, or captured oracle read. Historical registered_class fields in saved audit are explicitly not used.
source_contracts: locked cssparser0.37.0 src/parser.rs expect! macro, expect_exhausted
tests/support/csstree.rs ExpectedClass, ExpectedUnsupportedPolicy, UnsupportedReason, observation_from_report, payload_relation_holds
nonshadow.policy_separation: Pinned grammar decides semantic acceptance; project source owns code/actions/coordinate/multiplicity. matches optional alias is not adopted; full observation remains mandatory for exclusions. New exact predicates preserve same acceptance, do not widen it.

shadow.scope: 30 original host/host-context/slotted cases only; excludes other45 pseudo originals
shadow.method: Independent static diagnostic source-contract audit against immutable committed source. Preserves original75 audit grammar acceptance/rationale and typed expectations exactly. No parser/runtime/Cargo/currentregistry/oracle used as truth. This is expectation derivation, not an independent implementation review.

host.source_resolution: Latest published Scoping 1 at the cutoff. Section 3.2.1 defines the three host signatures. This edition does not define ::slotted(); its obsolete shadow-tree model and other selectors are not imported.

slotted.source_resolution: Selectors 4 explicitly references CSS Shadow 1. Its editor source identifies Scoping 1 as its predecessor, but no dated Shadow 1 publication is available at the cutoff and the last published Scoping edition lacks ::slotted(). This full source revision pins only the referenced ::slotted() definition; it does not replace any selected module edition or select the editor draft in full.

shadow.policy_separation: Grammar requirements come from independently pinned imported definitions; downstream host/slot matching is not grounds for exclusion. Diagnostic codes/actions/spans follow project public source contracts, not W3C-mandated vocabulary. All rejected observations contain one atomic RejectInput, full raw input span, multiplicity1. No retained implicit closure diagnostic follows outer rejection.

All inputs are ASCII.
